source_evidence: User exact '- Visit established friends and contacts.\n- Follow up on your three enchanted equipment inquiries.' Authorizes ordinary visits and obtaining information/quotes, not expenditures or acceptance. Current sources: accepted D325 morning chunk; campaign/continuity/npcs.md current scoped Maud/Pellin/Keepers and Cirren correspondence; archive/history-days-170-172.md and archive/history-days-196-199.md Exchange relationships; D324 actual Sabine correspondence; prep/dm-only/dm-orsaven-framework.md distinct delivery and ordinary contact rules; market rules.csv, dealers.csv and events.csv Day216 three named inquiries, v-design-references.csv source references and prior accepted exact effects. Pellin and Maud independent social responses within actual knowledge; Maud's recovery/work update is newly established in-play firsthand information, not a previously stored report; no extra quest, contract, or proof regarding the separate Keepers task. Sabine honors existing privacy and offers no new mail. D325 actual specialist follow-up, supplier DC12 +3 predeclared; genuine visible Python secrets receipt b898fd9fcdb994fe88d025075dd6ac11 face3 total6 fails, no firm offer or transaction, keep existing lead open. Established successful quillwright/needlecraft referrals have had 109 elapsed days to review designs; routine actual maker consultation confirms willingness and current material/bench feasibility, no additional arbitrary permission check. New conditional commission quotes: Hadiya 450gp (150 deposit/300 delivery), Wasp pair420gp (140 deposit/280 delivery); both28 days from separately agreed orders, no advance time or acceptance, no payment now. Source exact effects: Serpent Dart Book One111, action prime up to1min, first hit CON DC13 extra2d8 poison and poisoned1min as source, once/dawn; Hadiya Book Two97 returning physical dart, self-inking, once-dawn blinding ink on hit and ally action to clear, bonus-action feather tattoo storage/return, attunement; Wasp Book Two187 paired physical darts, two hits same eligible Large or smaller target restrain, DC13 STR action escape, once/dawn, mend1min/garment during short rest with materials. No additional magical mechanics imported. G1 source-grounded local commerce and prior relationships; G2 actionable optional quotes with realistic timing, failure of one supplier doesn't block the other two or unrelated play; G3 verified prior designs, separate maker authority, pricing and lead times proportionate to uncommon commissions, no manufactured combat or reward. D325~15:30 Orsaven, after ordinary city visits with V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar; own coach and four horses remain securely at Copper Hart. V chose visit established friends/contacts and follow up three specific enchanted equipment inquiries. Morning Pellin Arkwright at Exchange greets returning party warmly, recognizes prior commercial relationships and refers existing estate business to empowered stewards rather than assuming new contracts, no new payment/market commitment. At Keepers' receiving house Maud Rennick visits/greets party, confirms from own personal observation the four workers rescued D201 have recovered and resumed ordinary work; one is reluctant to take underground/quarry jobs again. No additional commission or new proof about burial hillside, Keepers' separate review remains open pending their actual report; no claimed link to Graven. Sabine Okoro at Concord of Factors receives friendly visit and respects Tobin's confidential correspondence; no further letter, address, consent to meet or personal disclosure. Afternoon actual visits Breakwater Smithy, Lark Street Letter Writer and Two Spindles Clothiers, following Day216 inquiries. Breakwater still cannot secure an available qualified renewable-poison specialist: actual independent supplier follow-up d20 3+trade3=6 vs predeclared DC12, new network opportunity after elapsed109days, not replay of earlier failed check; no quote, ready item, order, fee, reservation or permanently closed lead. Smith can keep looking or V may seek other qualified suppliers; no additional commission accepted. At Lark Street, known qualified quillwright has reviewed previously provided exact design, confirms current bench/material availability and one commission slot; offers one Hadiya's Handy Quill (Saddlebag Book Two p97, uncommon attunement) for 450gp, 150gp deposit and 300gp upon completed delivery, estimated 28 campaign days from accepted order, not current finished stock. At Two Spindles known specialist has reviewed paired design, confirms one commission slot and materials; offers one set Weaving Wasp Needles (Saddlebag Book Two p187, uncommon) for 420gp, 140gp deposit and 280gp upon completed delivery, estimated 28 campaign days from accepted order, no finished stock. Exact terms are newly established in-world quotes not historical prices or guaranteed completion; acceptance/lead time begins only when V agrees and pays, no expiry/hold or cash taken. Separate makers; no duplicated existing stock or automatic sword enchantment, physical darts, normal source effects and attunement. No major purchase or further quest chosen. User may negotiate/accept either/both quotes, pursue alternative Serpent supplier, or other activity. V purse2311gp8sp6cp; rations21/feed28; LR5/6, no D325 overnight or new inn fee. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped old shield retained, HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia equipped HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attacks +9, greataxe unchanged. All party/evidence/letter custody unchanged. Crown letter undelivered; frontier commission300+1300 and Coris300/800 contingent; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. Dice delegated until stop.
